title: Place order and decrement stock
whatWasDone: Signed-in customers can place an order from their cart.
Stock goes down by the ordered quantity as soon as the order is placed.
If an item is out of stock, the order is refused and the customer sees which item.
Clicking "Place order" twice quickly creates only one order.
A customer cannot open another customer's order.

environment.data: Product "Limited grinder" has 1 item in stock. Ask a developer to reset test data if it shows 0.
notes: Each run creates real test orders on staging; that is fine.

steps.action: Sign in as customer A and add "Espresso beans" and "Ceramic mug" to the cart, then open the cart.
steps.expected: Both items are listed with their prices and a total.
The page shows "Order placed" with an order number.

steps.action: Open the product page of "Ceramic mug" again.
steps.expected: Stock shown is 1 lower than before.

steps.action: Remove every item from the cart.
steps.expected: "Place order" is disabled and the page says "Cart is empty".

steps.action: Add 2 × "Limited grinder" to the cart and click "Place order".
steps.expected: The order is refused with "Limited grinder is out of stock". No order number appears.

edgeCases.expected: Only one order number appears, and "My orders" shows one new order.

edgeCases.action: While signed in as customer B, paste the address of customer A's order (from step 1.2).
edgeCases.expected: "Order not found". Customer A's order details are never shown.

howToReport: Click "Fail" on the step and write what you saw in the note box.
Add the account you used and the time; a screenshot link helps.
Tell the developer. Claude reads the failed steps and notes from this page and opens a bug for each.
